prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whoever loses his life for my sake, will find it in eternity, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quem perde a sua vida por causa de mim vai encontrá-la, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: A man of about forty with an ANGULAR face — a square forehead, prominent, sharply cut cheekbones, a straight Roman nose, dark, intense eyes under straight dark brows, a firm mouth and a strong jaw with a small cleft chin; olive southern-Italian skin, short dark hair curling under the mitre, clean-shaven, and a calm, resolute gaze lifted slightly upward.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the Neapolitan painting type (the Wikipedia lead image, consulted) shows a dark-haired, clean-shaven bishop in his prime with the ampoules of the blood and Vesuvius, which he is invoked against.

sources.title: New Liturgical Movement, Reliquary busts of the chapel of St Januarius in Naples
